welcome.title: Welcome from the Principal’s Desk
welcome.quote: Illuminating young hearts with the light of the Holy Quran and noble prophetic character is our sacred mission.
welcome.messageP1: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. On behalf of Lalmonirhat Model Madrasa (Nurani Academy), I extend our warmest greetings.
welcome.messageP2: Our core aim is to cultivate unwavering faith in Tawheed, deep love for the Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and upright moral integrity in our children from their earliest years. Simultaneously, we prepare them to excel in modern sciences, language, and technology.
welcome.messageP3: The collaborative dedication of our parents and faculty has turned this institution into a beacon of educational excellence. May Allah accept our endeavors.
welcome.name: Mawlana Muhammad Abdur Rahman

aboutSection.title: A Harmonious Blend of Islamic Faith & Academic Rigor
aboutSection.subtitle: Established in 2023, serving the Sadar Lalmonirhat community with dedicated Quranic grounding and high-standard primary academics.
aboutSection.historyDesc: Lalmonirhat Model Madrasa was founded in 2023 in response to the community's desire for a disciplined, values-based institution. Starting with its vibrant Nurani Academy from Play Group to Class Five, it has quickly grown into a trusted sanctuary of learning.
aboutSection.missionDesc: To educate and empower young minds grounded in the Holy Quran and Sunnah, enriched with moral character, patriotism, and modern scientific competence.
aboutSection.visionDesc: To emerge as the premier model Islamic primary institution in the northern region, guiding every student toward triumph in this life and the hereafter.
